fact: The DHIS2 Climate & Health country profile (updated July 2026) says DHIS2 has been used as Comoros's national health management information system since 2022, covering routine data on a range of health programmes.
DHIS2 says almost 99 percent of Comoros public health facilities already used DHIS2 for health service reporting.

DHIS2 says the eLMIS project, launched in 2024, links facility-level stock recording in the national DHIS2 platform with Open mSupply at central and regional warehouses, giving the Ministry end-to-end stock visibility.

La Gazette des Comores reports that the electronic vaccination register and the medicines and supplies management system are integrated with or interoperable with DHIS2, as presented at a 27 October 2026 coordination meeting.
